instructions: STAGE 3 CONTRACT — INPUT: frozen registered requirements, scene manifest/facts, and already accepted availability records. OUTPUT: exactly one assessment for each unassessed requirement, then seal_data_availability. REQUIRED INVARIANT for every row: set(available_inputs) union set(missing_inputs) must exactly equal that requirement's required_inputs and the two sets must be disjoint. Copy required_inputs before classifying them. condition_data_complete refers only to whether every applicability condition can be resolved from frozen facts and the selected TA; it does not mean that visual or measurement inputs have already been acquired. It may be true while data_availability is partial or not_attempted. available_direct means no required input is missing; partial requires both available and missing inputs; not_attempted means all required inputs remain missing but can be pursued in Stage 4. unavailable_after_attempt is forbidden in Stage 3 because evidence acquisition has not begun. The manifest's derivable_local list establishes feasibility only, not an acquired semantic input. Raw images, bbox records, lidar, trajectory, or calibration do not make an Observed..., Measured..., sign-legend, display-mode, device-condition, device-position, work-space-location, taper-location, or similar interpretation available. Keep such a required input in missing_inputs until the corresponding Stage 4 inspection or measurement tool actually returns the semantic result. A required input may be available_direct only when a non-null frozen scene fact or inventory field directly states that same value; cite that exact fact or inventory field. planned_tools must include measurement_spec.tool when data is usable; give a concrete evidence strategy and decision rule. Use get_scene_data_manifest and other inventory tools to distinguish direct, locally derivable, and absent data, but do not treat an inventory lookup as visual evidence. Never resubmit an accepted availability key. Do not call visual or geometry measurement tools. THIS REVIEW RUN MUST STOP IMMEDIATELY AFTER Stage 3 is sealed; no Stage 4 call is permitted.

It may be true while data_availability is partial or not_attempted. available_direct means no required input is missing; partial requires both available and missing inputs; not_attempted means all required inputs remain missing but can be pursued in Stage 4. unavailable_after_attempt is forbidden in Stage 3 because evidence acquisition has not begun.
